title: Land Still to be Conquered

questions.question: What did the Lord say to Joshua when he was old and advanced in years?
options: There remains yet very much land to possess
questions.correctAnswer: There remains yet very much land to possess
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:1 (ESV): "...and there remains yet very much land to possess."

questions.question: Which tribe received no inheritance of land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:14 (ESV): "To the tribe of Levi alone Moses gave no inheritance..."

questions.question: What was the inheritance of the tribe of Levi?
options: The offerings by fire to the Lord God of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The offerings by fire to the Lord God of Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:14 (ESV): "the offerings by fire to the Lord God of Israel are their inheritance..."

questions.question: What notable person was killed by the sword along with the princes of Midian?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:22 (ESV): "Balaam also, the son of Beor... the people of Israel killed with the sword..."

questions.question: Which tribes received their inheritance east of the Jordan?
options: Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:8 (ESV): "With the other half of the tribe of Manasseh the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance..."

questions.question: Did the people of Israel drive out the Geshurites and the Maacathites?
options: No, they dwell in the midst of Israel to this day
questions.correctAnswer: No, they dwell in the midst of Israel to this day
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:13 (ESV): "Yet the people of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites..."

questions.question: What river formed the boundary of the Reubenites?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:23 (ESV): "And the border of the people of Reuben was the Jordan as a boundary."

questions.question: How many lords of the Philistines remained?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:3 (ESV): "...the five rulers of the Philistines..."

questions.question: The inheritance of Gad included which specific city related to Gilead?
What was the condition of the land to be possessed regarding the Sidonians?
options: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim
questions.correctAnswer: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:6 (ESV): "all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, even all the Sidonians."

questions.question: Why did Moses give no inheritance to the tribe of Levi in verse 33?
options: The Lord God of Israel is their inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord God of Israel is their inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:33 (ESV): "But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the Lord God of Israel is their inheritance..."

questions.question: Who is mentioned as the soothsayer/diviner killed by Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:22 (ESV): "Balaam also, the son of Beor, the one who practiced divination..."

questions.question: Machir was the firstborn of whom?
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:31 (ESV): "...for the half of the people of the children of Machir the son of Manasseh..."

questions.question: Where were these inheritances distributed by Moses?
options: In the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan east of Jericho
questions.correctAnswer: In the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan east of Jericho
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:32 (ESV): "These are the inheritances that Moses distributed in the plains of Moab..."

questions.question: What specific region did Og king of Bashan rule over?
options: Mount Hermon and Salecah and all Bashan
questions.correctAnswer: Mount Hermon and Salecah and all Bashan
questions.explanation: Joshua 13:11-12 (ESV): "...and all Bashan to Salecah; all the kingdom of Og in Bashan..."

key_verse_text: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to possess. (ESV)
